import pandas as pd

# Load source table
source_path_0 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_11/training_0.csv"
df_source_0 = pd.read_csv(source_path_0, index_col=0)

# Perform the transformation as per operation_history:
# group_by = [Source3_11_0.SN]
# aggregations = [sum(Source3_11_0.Price), count(Source3_11_0.Purchase ID)]

# Group by 'SN', sum 'Price', count 'Purchase ID'
df_target = df_source_0.groupby('SN', as_index=False).agg({
    'Price': 'sum',
    'Purchase ID': 'count'
})

# Rename columns to match target schema
df_target.rename(columns={'Purchase ID': 'count'}, inplace=True)

# Ensure target schema types: ['SN': string, 'Price': float, 'count': integer]

df_target['Price'] = df_target['Price'].astype(float)
df_target['count'] = df_target['count'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_11/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source table with index_col=0 as per Hint 21
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_11/training_0.csv", index_col=0)

# Group by SN, aggregate sum of Price and count of Purchase ID
result = source0.groupby("SN", as_index=False).agg(
    Price=pd.NamedAgg(column="Price", aggfunc="sum"),
    count=pd.NamedAgg(column="Purchase ID", aggfunc="count")
)

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_11/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
